title: NEPA Match Night
tagline: 85th minute. Super Eagles level. Then the light goes.

blackout.title: Light Don Go
blackout.text: The Super Eagles are level in the 85th minute and NEPA chooses this exact moment to strike. The whole compound screams.

choices.label: Sweet-talk the neighbour with the generator
Run to the junction for fuel
Check if it is just your fuse

fuel_queue.title: The Fuel Queue
fuel_queue.text: The petrol station has a queue that bends around two streets. Someone is already selling fuel in plastic bottles at triple price.

choices.label: Give up and listen on radio

neighbour_tv.title: Oga Next Door
neighbour_tv.text: Your neighbour has a generator and a big TV, but half the street is already in his sitting room.

choices.label: Carry drinks as your entry fee
Offer to fetch fuel for him

generator_on.title: Gen Don Start
generator_on.text: The generator roars to life and everyone cheers, but the sound is so loud nobody can hear the commentary.

choices.label: Run an extension to the TV

viewing_centre.title: The Viewing Centre
viewing_centre.text: You find a packed viewing centre with a giant screen, one seat left, and two people eyeing it.

choices.label: Offer to buy the next round
Stand where the view is best

final_whistle.title: Final Whistle
final_whistle.text: The match ends. Time to celebrate, or argue about the referee.
